title: Git-is-the-arbiter overstates git merge semantics
description: QE defect: three-way merge can auto-merge non-overlapping state-field edits into a clean-but-inconsistent file. Fix: name mdatron's state-consistency check as the backstop in the resolution, and add a concurrent-boundary fixture (clean-merge-inconsistent-state caught by the consistency check). [owner: quality-engineer; validator: solution-architect]
